text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O overtakes Nishino Flower 
and seizes a magnificent victory!

Confident that she could go the distance 
even at a mile now that she had grown so 
magnificently, the Trainer decided to 
enter her into the Mile Championship.

Sakura Bakushin O will finally... stretch 
her distance a tiny bit beyond sprints and 
take on the challenge of a mile race!
